intro.line: One goal, several agents. One of them in the cloud.

shots.label: deep-plan families
shots.line: One goal, three plans: a parent and two workstreams.

shots.label: The Dock
shots.line: The family is one card. Each member says what it waits on.

shots.label: Cloud sandbox (simulated)
shots.line: One workstream runs in the cloud. Its plan came down a git branch.

shots.label: Sequencing
shots.line: A workstream can't start before the parent's step.

shots.label: The parent
shots.line: The parent checks its gate and asks. You say go.

shots.label: The parent
shots.line: It lands the shared step, then asks about the cloud.

shots.label: Delegated go
shots.line: A second yes. The go travels on the state branch.

shots.label: Cloud sandbox
shots.line: The go arrives from the branch. The cloud agent builds.

shots.label: Back on the laptop
shots.line: The laptop pulls the branch and sees the work land.
